audio.t: Hello, this is Paul Reyes. I have an appointment with Dr. Chen next Tuesday at ten, but I need to change it.
Certainly, Mr. Reyes. Let me look at her schedule. Actually, Dr. Chen will be away at a medical conference all of next week.
Oh, I didn't know that. Then could I see her the week after?
She has an opening on Wednesday the fourteenth at two thirty. Would that work for you?
That's perfect. Should I bring my insurance card again?
We already have it on file, so you don't need to. But please bring the results of your recent blood test, since she'll want to review them.
Will do. Thanks for your help.

questions.q: Why is the man calling?
questions.explain: Người đàn ông nói 'I need to change it' (cần đổi lịch hẹn). Các đáp án khác không được nhắc tới là lý do gọi.

questions.q: What does the woman say about Dr. Chen?
options: She will be away at a conference.
She is moving to a new clinic.
She no longer sees new patients.
She has changed her phone number.
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ nói 'Dr. Chen will be away at a medical conference all of next week'.

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man to bring?
questions.explain: 'Please bring the results of your recent blood test'. Thẻ bảo hiểm (A) là bẫy: bà nói không cần mang vì đã có hồ sơ.

audio.t: Line 3 stopped twice this morning, Nadia. We've already fallen behind on the bottle-cap order.
I know. I checked it, and the problem is a faulty sensor. It keeps telling the machine that the conveyor is jammed when it isn't.
How long will it take to fix? My team on that line is just standing around.
The replacement part arrived yesterday, so I'll install it this afternoon. It should take about three hours.
In the meantime, why don't I move my workers over to Line 2? They could help with the labeling.
Good thinking, Tom. Let's do that, and I'll let the client know the order might be a day late.

questions.q: What problem are the speakers discussing?
options: A faulty sensor on a production line
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ nói 'the problem is a faulty sensor' trên dây chuyền số 3.

questions.q: What does the woman say she will do this afternoon?
questions.explain: 'The replacement part arrived yesterday, so I'll install it this afternoon'.

questions.q: What does the second man suggest?
options: Temporarily moving workers to another line
questions.explain: M2 đề nghị 'move my workers over to Line 2' (chuyển công nhân sang dây chuyền 2 tạm thời).

audio.t: Good morning. I have your regular delivery of fruit and vegetables. Where would you like me to put the crates?
Just inside the cold storage room, please. Actually, before you unload, there's something I need to mention. Last week, the strawberries arrived in pretty bad shape. About half of them were mushy.
I'm sorry to hear that. Our truck's cooling system was being repaired, which is probably the reason.
Well, it cost us quite a bit, because we had to throw them away. Could you open one of today's boxes so we can both see the condition?
Of course. Let me take a look right now, and if there's a problem, I'll note it on the invoice.
Thanks. I'd appreciate that.

questions.q: Who most likely is the man?
questions.explain: Anh ta mang 'your regular delivery of fruit and vegetables' và nhắc 'our truck' nên là tài xế giao hàng.

questions.q: What does the woman say happened last week?
options: A truck was involved in an accident.
A shipment of berries arrived damaged.
questions.explain: 'Last week, the strawberries arrived in pretty bad shape' → lô dâu đến nơi bị hỏng.

questions.q: What will the man most likely do next?
questions.explain: Anh ta đáp 'Let me take a look right now' sau khi được nhờ mở một thùng để kiểm tra tình trạng.

audio.t: Hi, I'm opening a small bakery next month, and I'd like to set up a business checking account.
Congratulations! We can certainly help with that. To get started, I'll need a copy of your business license, along with some photo identification.
I have my ID, but the license is still being processed by the city. It should arrive by Friday.
No problem. You can come back once you have it. And since you're a new business, I can waive the account setup fee if you open the account before the end of the month.
That's great news. I'll stop by on Monday, then.
Wonderful. I'll write my name on this card, so you can ask for me directly.

questions.q: What does the woman want to do?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'I'd like to set up a business checking account'.

questions.q: What does the man say is required?
options: A copy of her business license
questions.explain: 'I'll need a copy of your business license, along with some photo identification'.

questions.q: What does the man offer to do?
options: Arrange a meeting with a loan officer
questions.explain: 'I can waive the account setup fee' (miễn phí mở tài khoản) nếu mở trước cuối tháng.

audio.t: Excuse me, my six-forty train to Brookfield was canceled this morning, and I'd like to get my money back.
I'm sorry about that, sir. There's a track repair delay on that line. There's another train at seven thirty, if you'd like to take that.
No, thanks. I have to be at a meeting by eight, so it's too late for me. I'm going to drive instead.
I understand. Since you bought your ticket on our app, I can't refund it here at the window. The easiest way is to fill out the refund form on our website.
How long will that take?
Usually about five business days, and the money goes straight to your card.

questions.q: Where is the conversation most likely taking place?
options: At a train station ticket window
questions.explain: Có 'train', 'track repair' và 'refund it here at the window' → quầy vé ga tàu.

questions.q: What problem does the man mention?
questions.explain: 'My six-forty train to Brookfield was canceled this morning'.

questions.q: What does the woman suggest?
options: Filling out an online refund form
Exchanging the ticket for a bus pass
questions.explain: 'The easiest way is to fill out the refund form on our website'. Chuyến 7:30 (A) cô có đề cập nhưng anh đã từ chối.

audio.t: Hi, I run a small writing club, and I'd like to reserve a room here for a Saturday workshop. We'd have about twelve people.
We have two meeting rooms. Room B seats up to fifteen, so that would be perfect. But I should mention that rooms must be reserved at least a week in advance.
That's fine. The workshop is three weeks from now. Is there a charge?
Not for library cardholders. Do you have a card?
Yes, I do. Here it is.
Great. Then all you need to do is complete this reservation form, and I'll enter it into the system.

questions.q: What is the man interested in doing?
options: Reserving a room for a workshop
questions.explain: 'I'd like to reserve a room here for a Saturday workshop'.

questions.q: What does the woman say about the rooms?
options: They can seat up to fifty people.
They must be reserved a week in advance.
questions.explain: 'Rooms must be reserved at least a week in advance'. Phòng chứa tối đa 15 người, không phải 50.

questions.q: What will the man most likely do next?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ nói 'all you need to do is complete this reservation form'. Không mất phí với người có thẻ thư viện.

audio.t: Okay, the Hartwell Foods presentation is on Thursday morning. Is everything ready?
Almost. The slides look great, but the promotional video runs nearly five minutes. This client prefers short ads, so I think we should cut it down to three.
I agree. The ending drags a bit. I can trim it tonight, no problem.
Thanks, Raymond. I'll book the boardroom and make sure the projector is working.
And let's do a quick rehearsal on Wednesday afternoon, just to be safe.
Good idea. I'll send a calendar invitation to everyone.

questions.q: What are the speakers preparing for?
questions.explain: Mở đầu: 'the Hartwell Foods presentation is on Thursday morning' – buổi thuyết trình cho khách hàng.

questions.q: What does the woman say about the video?
options: It was made by another company.
questions.explain: 'We should cut it down to three [minutes]' – nên rút ngắn video.

questions.q: What does the second man say he will do?
questions.explain: M2 nói 'I can trim it tonight' (cắt gọn video tối nay). Đặt phòng là việc của người đàn ông đầu tiên.

audio.t: I wanted to talk about the new scheduling system the hospital is installing next month. Patients will be able to book and change appointments online.
That sounds convenient, but I'm a little worried about the front-desk staff. A few of them aren't comfortable with new software, and they might need some training.
That's already taken care of, Mr. Alvarez. The software company is sending a trainer to our department on Monday morning.
Oh, good. How long will the session last?
About two hours. We'll hold it in the staff lounge so that everyone can attend.
Wonderful. I'll send out a reminder email this afternoon.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ mở đầu bằng 'the new scheduling system the hospital is installing next month'.

questions.q: What concern does the man raise?
options: Patients may not have internet access.
questions.explain: Anh lo 'a few of them aren't comfortable with new software, and they might need some training'.

questions.q: What does the second woman say will happen on Monday?
options: A training session will be held.
A new receptionist will start work.
The old system will be turned off.
A survey will be sent to patients.
questions.explain: W2: 'The software company is sending a trainer to our department on Monday morning'.

audio.t: Thanks for meeting me, Mr. Brooks. I'm the safety inspector from the city, and I'll be checking your assembly area today.
Of course. Please let me know if you need anything. We passed the inspection last year.
Yes, I saw that in the report. Everything looks fine so far, but there are a lot of cardboard boxes stacked in front of the east emergency exit.
Oh, they were put there this morning after a delivery. I'll have my team move them before the end of the day.
I'd appreciate that. I'll come back around four to confirm.
Thanks for pointing it out. We'd better find a proper storage spot for deliveries.

questions.q: What is the woman's job?
questions.explain: 'I'm the safety inspector from the city'.

questions.q: What problem does the woman point out?
options: A fire alarm is not working.
questions.explain: Có nhiều thùng carton 'in front of the east emergency exit' (chặn lối thoát hiểm).

questions.q: What does the man promise to do?
questions.explain: 'I'll have my team move them before the end of the day' – dọn các thùng trong hôm nay.

audio.t: Hello, I'm Jorge from Casa Verde Foods. I was hoping to set up a tasting table for our new salsa this Saturday.
Thanks for asking. Unfortunately, Saturday will be tough. We're having our anniversary sale, so the aisles will be packed, and we won't have space for tables.
I see. What about the following weekend?
That should work. To confirm, could you drop off a few jars as samples ahead of time? Our manager likes to try everything before approving a promotion.
Sure, I can bring some by on Wednesday.
Perfect. I'll let her know to expect you.

questions.q: What does the man want to do?
questions.explain: 'I was hoping to set up a tasting table for our new salsa'.

questions.q: What does the woman say about this Saturday?
options: Some staff will be on vacation.
The parking lot will be repaired.
The store will hold a special sale.
questions.explain: 'We're having our anniversary sale' vào thứ Bảy này nên cửa hàng sẽ đông.

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man to do?
questions.explain: 'Could you drop off a few jars as samples ahead of time?'

audio.t: Good afternoon, Mr. Lim. This is Dana from Crestline Bank's fraud department. I'm calling about unusual activity on your credit card.
Oh no. What kind of activity?
There was a charge of nine hundred dollars at an electronics store in another country this morning. Did you make that purchase?
No, I haven't left the city in months. That's definitely not mine.
Thank you for confirming. I'll cancel the card right away, and we'll mail you a replacement within three business days.
Great. Will I be responsible for that charge?
Not at all. We'll remove it from your account today.

questions.q: Why is the woman calling?
questions.explain: 'I'm calling about unusual activity on your credit card' – báo hoạt động đáng ngờ.

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man to confirm?
options: Whether he made a recent purchase
questions.explain: 'Did you make that purchase?' – xác nhận giao dịch 900 đô có phải của anh không.

questions.q: What will the bank do?
questions.explain: 'We'll mail you a replacement within three business days' – gửi thẻ thay thế.

audio.t: Hi, I'm thinking about getting a monthly pass. I ride the number 8 bus into the city every weekday, and the single fares are adding up.

A monthly pass is forty-five dollars, which would save you quite a bit. But if you plan to keep riding for a full year, I'd suggest the annual pass instead. It works out to about thirty-five dollars a month.
That's a big difference. Do I have to pay for the whole year at once?
You can, or you can pay in two installments. Either way, you'll get a free replacement if you lose the card.
Okay, let me think about it. Can I get a brochure?
Sure, here you go.

questions.q: What are the speakers discussing?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ nói 'I'm thinking about getting a monthly pass' và hai người bàn về các loại vé tháng/năm.

questions.q: What does the woman say she does every weekday?
options: Rides the bus into the city
questions.explain: 'I ride the number 8 bus into the city every weekday'.

questions.q: What does the man recommend?
questions.explain: 'I'd suggest the annual pass instead' vì rẻ hơn, khoảng 35 đô mỗi tháng.

audio.t: Thanks for joining me, both of you. As you know, we want to digitize the library's collection of old local newspapers, so people can search them online.
That's a huge project. Do we have enough money for the equipment?
Yes. The Hollis Foundation gave us a donation that covers the scanner and the software, and the rest comes from our regular budget.
Great. I'm the one who'll operate the scanner, so I'd like to try it out first. I'll test the machine next week, once it's delivered.
Excellent. Meanwhile, I'll ask the volunteer group whether anyone can help with sorting the papers.
Perfect. Let's meet again in two weeks to check our progress.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: A project to digitize old newspapers
A move to a new building
questions.explain: 'We want to digitize the library's collection of old local newspapers'.

questions.q: What does the woman say about the budget?
options: It must be approved by the city.
It will pay for additional staff.
It is smaller than last year's.
questions.explain: 'The Hollis Foundation gave us a donation that covers the scanner and the software, and the rest comes from our regular budget'.

questions.q: What does the second man say he will do next week?
questions.explain: M2: 'I'll test the machine next week, once it's delivered' (machine = scanner). Tìm tình nguyện viên là việc của người đàn ông thứ nhất.
